svg.title: Kelp Apothecary — Hanging kelp gardens, drying racks and a sea-glass mixing hut
svg.desc: Kelp racks rise through three sheltered terraces to a mixing room. Mortar tables, crate steps and drying beams offer low hops beside proper stairs.

Kelp racks rise through three sheltered terraces to a mixing room. Mortar tables, crate steps and drying beams
